Visit <https://example.com/path> in a paragraph.

Trailing punct after <https://example.com>.

Marked **<https://example.com>** stays a link inside strong.

In a list:

- see <https://example.com/item>
- also <http://example.com/plain>

> quote with <https://example.com/q>

## Heading <https://example.com/h>

After angle autolinks.
